title: stream.validate request

cache_scope.description: Base-analysis cache scope for dynamic=true only. full (default) caches the complete FSDB; range requires a non-empty time_range and caches that normalized interval. Omit this argument when dynamic=false.

channel.description: 协议或 stream 的逻辑 channel 选择；可用值由本 action 的 enum 决定。

dynamic.description: 为 true 时允许本 action 已声明的运行时动态检查；不开放未声明字段。

line_limit.description: Limits returned evidence rows only, not scanning, aggregation, or the verdict; read completeness fields as well.

render_time_unit.description: Controls only canonical response time rendering: auto, ps, ns, or us. It never changes input parsing, sampling, filtering, or ordering.

stream.description: 已加载的 stream 配置名称。

begin.description: 闭区间起点；省略时使用可用波形窗口起点。

end.description: 闭区间终点；省略时使用可用波形窗口终点。

time_range.description: Closed analysis interval. begin and end may be omitted independently to use the available waveform bounds.

timeout_ms.description: Positive public frontend-to-engine request timeout in milliseconds. Omit limits.timeout_ms to disable the public watchdog.

description: Validate stream configuration and observed behavior; dynamic validation supports explicit full or range base-cache scope.
x-how_it_works: static validation 不建 base；dynamic:true 与 query/export 复用 cache_scope 选择的 base。
x-when_to_use: 提前发现错误信号路径和动态流行为问题。
x-arg_contract_notes: required: stream; cache_scope: full(default) / range only when dynamic=true
x-description-zh: 验证 stream 配置；动态验证可显式选择 full 或 range 基础分析缓存范围。

use_when: Validate stream configuration statically, or reuse an explicit full/range base analysis for dynamic validation.
do_not_use_when: Do not use it to return transfer evidence or export artifacts.
constraints: required: stream; cache_scope: full(default) / range only when dynamic=true
